Job Summary

Halcyon Freight Systems is hiring a Sales Development Representative to support outbound
pipeline generation for the winter 2027 work term.

Responsibilities

- Qualify inbound leads and book discovery meetings for account executives
- Maintain prospect records and activity logging in the CRM
- Support weekly prospecting reviews with the sales team

Qualifications

- Enrolled in a business, commerce, or marketing program
- Comfortable with high-volume outreach

Work Term: Winter 2027
